evidence.finding: background delegate completion is queued and later forged as a fresh turn
delegate_task can dispatch detached work and return a handle
completion, event, delivery state, attempts and claims are persisted in profile-local state.db
undelivered completions are restored after process restart

parent_wakeup.finding: Native CLI and persistent gateway channels can inject a synthetic new turn. AOTA Profile Task is a separate hermes -z process and has no call into this path.

desktop_event_replay.finding: Desktop WebSocket reconnect has no event cursor/replay handshake; it can reload persisted session messages after the backend has processed a completion.

cross_profile_delivery.finding: Each named profile has its own state.db; native async_delegations and messages are profile-local.

aota_native_integration.finding: AOTA finalization writes a filesystem outbox and an adapter intended for WebUI SessionChannel/SSE, not Hermes process_registry completion_queue or gateway.wake.
